kyoto_unagi_to_coffee.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled eel glazed with a long-kept tare, unaju with clear soup and pickles, Basque cheesecake; no gluten information (own site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_unagi_to_coffee.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant; sides include river fish, shrimp and dashimaki, and the soup is clam or eel liver (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_unagi_to_coffee.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:00–17:00; closed Monday and some irregular days (Tabelog). The shop’s site lists 11:00–18:00, closed Monday — the Tabelog hours are used. Reservations accepted (June 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: a counter in front of the grill and several tables for two (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Matsubara-dori west of Yamatooji, right behind the river-fish shop のと正, 5 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo (own site; December 2025). Site opened August 2024 (own site).
kyoto_unagi_to_coffee.notes: [Unagi and coffee · Matsubara-dori behind のと正] A stylish 14-seat counter-and-tables café behind the old river-fish shop のと正, grilling eel over binchotan in front of you, Kansai style, with that shop’s tare — unaju from ¥3,900 — then house-roasted coffee and Basque cheesecake. Daytime only; closed Monday. Flagged: a sister concept of のと正, which is already listed.

chef_bio.background: The shop’s site says it uses the tare of のと正, kept topped up for 60 years, with eel from Shizuoka. Reviewers say it is run by のと正, a long-established river-fish shop nearby (December 2025, January 2026), and two reviewers say it was started by a daughter of that family (June 2026). Tabelog’s shop text mentions a collaboration with Kawagoe Fishery.
chef_bio.philosophy: Away from the bustle of the city, a slow, happy hour of eel, good drink and coffee roasted to match (own site).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner expected so-so eel from a café with a quirky name, then watched it grilled over binchotan and was won over.
An April 2026 visitor had lunch here before the Kyo Odori dances in Miyagawa-cho.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 鰻と、COFFEE、東山区松原通大和大路西入弓矢町31-1、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、11時〜18時 (月曜定休)、60年前から追い足す「のと正」のタレ、静岡の鰻、炭火焼き、新潟産コシヒカリ、自家焙煎のスペシャルティコーヒー、うな重 上 3,900円、特上 5,200円、Premium (冷酒ミニボトル付き) 7,200円、白焼、う巻き、鮎の塩焼きなど季節の料理、宇治の玉露700円、2024年8月に公式サイト公開。食べログ: うなぎ・カフェ、火〜日 11:00〜17:00、月曜定休、14席、カード・電子マネー・QR可、Kawagoe Fisheryとのコラボ。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 備長炭で焼く関西風の鰻、のと正が営む、川魚や海老と豆などの小鉢、だし巻き、はまぐりのお吸い物、うなぎ茶漬け2,900円、バスクチーズケーキ3種。

cultural_comfort.note: Café-style counter; warm, informal service (2026 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_tozanbo_tamanohikari.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki, sukiyaki and shabu-shabu, yudofu and fugu pots; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_tozanbo_tamanohikari.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki with fish, wagyu sukiyaki and shabu-shabu (Tabelog). A yudofu pot is one of the hot-pot choices — ask about dashi (Tabelog).
kyoto_tozanbo_tamanohikari.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday and Sunday 12:00–21:00; Friday 12:00–14:30 and 17:00–21:30; Saturday 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–21:30 (Tabelog). Reservations taken. Cards and e-money accepted; cashless only (Tabelog). 5% service charge (Tabelog). 70 seats over two floors with private rooms looking over the Kamo River; a riverside yuka terrace in season, with an indoor seat held in case of rain; wheelchair and stroller access to the riverside; non-smoking, including the terrace (Tabelog; July 2025). Insects can be a nuisance on the terrace after dark (2024 and 2026 reviews). On Pontocho north of Shijo, 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi or Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_tozanbo_tamanohikari.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Pontocho, a townhouse on the Kamo yuka] A Pontocho townhouse with private rooms and a summer yuka terrace over the Kamo River, looking across to Higashiyama. Kyoto kaiseki, wagyu sukiyaki and seasonal hot pots — hamo in summer, fugu in winter — with a small-pot kaiseki at ¥6,600. Cashless; 5% service; wheelchair access to the riverside.

chef_bio.background: Run by 有限会社シーアンドディー (C&D) of Shimogyo (National Tax Agency invoice register T7130002023987), a Kyoto company whose site lists Pontocho and Kiyamachi restaurants such as 眺河 and bars. The shop serves Kyoto cuisine with Tamanohikari sake in a Pontocho townhouse (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto kaiseki and hot pots by the Kamo River.

anecdotes.text: A May 2024 guest, rained off the yuka, was given a 2nd-floor room and watched a white heron in the rain.
A February 2025 visitor ate while watching snow fall outside the window.
A July 2025 diner on a first river-terrace dinner had the Kobe beef sukiyaki and noted the terrace is non-smoking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 東山望 TAMANOHIKARI、日本料理・しゃぶしゃぶ、京都市中京区先斗町四条上ル鍋屋町228、阪急京都河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩2分、月〜木・日 12:00〜21:00、金 12:00〜14:30・17:00〜21:30、土 11:30〜14:30・17:00〜21:30、予約可、カード・電子マネー可、キャッシュレスのみ、サービス料5%、70席 (1階・2階、個室)、禁煙、鴨川の床、車椅子・ベビーカーで川床へ、雨の場合は室内席も確保、玉乃光の酒、小鍋会席 (和牛すき焼き・鴨すき・とらふぐ・湯豆腐から選択、1ドリンク付き) 6,600円、京都平井牛と神戸牛の食べ比べ会席9,900円、インボイス T7130002023987 (有限会社シーアンドディー)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 町家、鴨川と東山の眺め、御膳ランチ (刺身、湯豆腐、ぶりの西京焼き、じゃこ山椒ご飯)、鱧しゃぶ、鮎、神戸牛のすき焼き、すき焼き御膳、床は禁煙、夜は虫が多い。

existence.note: Tabelog official listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_ryoriya_toki.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal kaiseki: sashimi, clear soups, charcoal-grilled fish and meat, tempura, ochazuke; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_ryoriya_toki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki of fish, eel and meat (official site; reviews).
kyoto_ryoriya_toki.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:30, reservation only), dinner 17:00–22:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog; official site). Reservations advised — often full (April 2026). Cash or cards; no e-money (official site). 16 seats: 8 at the counter, small tables and a semi-private room looking over the Takase River; non-smoking (official site; 2024–2026 reviews). Solo diners welcome at the counter (official site). On the corner of Kiyamachi and Bukkoji, about 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (official site).
kyoto_ryoriya_toki.notes: [Kaiseki · Kiyamachi on the Takase River, small and seasonal] A 16-seat kaiseki-kappo on the corner of Kiyamachi and Bukkoji, sister of りょうりや 御旅屋, cooking fish and meat over charcoal in a kamado. Dinner courses from ¥7,500 or a la carte at the counter — sashimi, Lake Biwa ayu, mountain-vegetable tempura. Takase River views; often full, so book; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: The official greeting, dated the opening on 23 August 2020, is signed by owner 原田 祐司, who runs Toki as the sibling shop of りょうりや 御旅屋 on Nishikiyamachi at Takatsuji. The name means "season".
chef_bio.philosophy: Serve each season’s best food casually and at a fair price (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; charcoal-grilled fish and meat.

anecdotes.text: On the fourth anniversary in August 2024, a local who walks a dog along the path outside was poured complimentary sake.
A March 2025 traveller, turned away by the full main restaurant, was sent to this sister shop.
An April 2026 guest found a "Fully Booked" sign at the door and was glad to have reserved ten days ahead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: りょうりや 季 (TOKI)、京都河原町駅から徒歩圏内の会席・割烹店、京都市下京区市之町260-1 仏光寺角、京都河原町駅から徒歩約5分、16席 (カウンター8、テーブル8)、禁煙、現金・カード可、電子マネー不可、姉妹店「りょうりや御旅屋」、かまど (おくどさん) で肉と魚を炭火焼き、気軽に楽しめる会席料理、ディナーはアラカルトも可、夜の部コース7,500円・9,500円・11,500円、ご挨拶は店主 原田祐司 (令和2年8月23日開店)。食べログ: 12:00〜15:00 (L.O.13:30、昼は予約のみ)・17:00〜22:00、水曜定休。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 高瀬川の眺め、カウンター、半個室、刺身盛り合わせ1,500円から、ホタルイカの酢味噌1,400円、京都の筍の炭火焼き1,500円、山菜の天ぷら1,400円、琵琶湖の鮎の塩焼き、めひかり、海鮮茶漬け、鱧の椀、4周年、満席が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; counter welcomes solo diners; book ahead.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026. Tabelog still carries a 2023 closing notice, contradicted by the site and later reviews.

kyoto_yohei_sushi_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae sushi with red-vinegar rice; small dishes such as eel chawanmushi; no gluten information is published (TableCheck; reviews).
kyoto_yohei_sushi_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an Edomae sushi course (Tabelog).
kyoto_yohei_sushi_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 20:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations taken; allergies or dislikes affecting two or more dishes are treated as a cancellation — say so when booking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 10% service charge (Tabelog). 26 seats: a counter and private rooms for 2 and 4; non-smoking (Tabelog; TableCheck). Large windows on the Kamo River (Tabelog; September 2026). On the ground floor of HANAMIYA on Kiyamachi above Matsubara, 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi or Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_yohei_sushi_kiyamachi.notes: [Sushi · Kiyamachi by the Kamo, Edomae courses] A new Edomae sushi counter in a hotel building on Kiyamachi, with solid-wood fittings and big windows on the Kamo River. Red-vinegar rice and omakase courses from ¥8,800 to ¥27,500 at lunch and dinner. Private rooms; 10% service; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in May 2026 on the ground floor of HANAMIYA (Tabelog). A May 2026 reviewer calls it a new restaurant of the Kyoto Saeki group, opened with a hotel’s backing; a September 2026 reviewer says the chef comes from an Edomae sushi background.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 couple were the only guests on a rainy day before the hotel had opened.
A September 2026 diner singled out the deep-red whale nigiri.
A June 2026 diner found the taste almost the same as at Saeki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都 与兵衛、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、京都市下京区木屋町通松原上る三丁目天王町155-1 HANAMIYA 1F、京都河原町駅・祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、昼11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)・夜18:00〜22:00 (L.O.20:30)、水曜定休、予約可、アレルギーや苦手な食材がコースの2品以上に及ぶ場合はキャンセル扱い、カード・電子マネー・QR可、サービス料10%、26席、個室 (2名・4名)、2026年5月1日オープン、鴨川を望む大きな窓、おまかせ8,800円、昼のコース16,500円 (3品・握り10貫・甘味)・27,500円 (4品・握り12貫・甘味)。TableCheck: 鮨屋与兵衛 京都、江戸前寿司、赤酢の酢飯、クロマグロ、いわし。口コミ (2026年、英語): 京都の佐伯グループの新店、ホテルの1階、鰻の茶碗蒸し、鯨の握り、江戸前出身の職人。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards and QR accepted; private rooms; 10% service.

existence.note: Tabelog official listing and TableCheck page; reviews dated May–September 2026.

kyoto_pontocho_tanrakuya_toriume.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori comes with house tare or mizu-shio (salt water) (official site); the menu also has chicken-broth udon and grilled rice balls (2024–25 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_pontocho_tanrakuya_toriume.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori house built on chicken broth — even the appetizer is tofu in chicken broth (April 2025).
kyoto_pontocho_tanrakuya_toriume.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Tuesday and every other Wednesday (Tabelog); the official site says closed Tuesday and alternate Mondays or Wednesdays; closing times may vary (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, incl. by phone on the day (Tabelog; August 2026). Appetizer charge ¥500 per person, included in courses (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「お通し500円/人（コースご利用の場合は料金に含まれてます）」); a July 2026 bill showed ¥550. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 24 seats: 8 at the counter, 16 at tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Pontocho Building 1F, Pontocho south of Sanjo, 3 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog). Opened 11 April 2012 (Tabelog).
kyoto_pontocho_tanrakuya_toriume.notes: [Yakitori · Pontocho, since 2012] A small charcoal yakitori house at the Sanjo end of Pontocho, grilling Tanba chicken over Tosa binchotan with house tare or salt water, plus rare cuts like comb, a pâté-rich simmered liver and a chicken-broth finale of fried rice balls or udon. Over 20 local sakes. Good-value courses from ¥3,960; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and the official site: a yakitori restaurant opened in April 2012 in Pontocho, grilling carefully chosen chicken over Tosa binchotan, with local sake selected by a kikisake-shi (sake sommelier).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 diner tried chicken comb for the first time and found the simmered liver as rich as a pâté.
An April 2025 visitor would travel from Osaka just for the fried rice balls soaked in chicken broth.
A February 2026 diner suggests ordering à la carte rather than a course to try the unusual dishes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ・公式サイト: 焼鳥・居酒屋、中京区先斗町三条下ル橋下町135 先斗町ビル 1F、京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、月・水〜日17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、火曜と隔週水曜休み (公式サイトは火曜と隔週月曜か水曜)、予約可、お通し500円 (コースは込み)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、24席 (カウンター8、テーブル16)、禁煙、英語メニュー、2012年4月11日オープン、Tanba の鶏を土佐備長炭で、自家製のタレと水塩、利酒師が選んだ地酒20種以上 (京都の酒約10種)、コース3,960円・5,500円・飲み放題付き6,160円。口コミ (2023年6月〜2026年8月、英語): 鶏スープの雑炊、生麩の田楽、レバー煮、Kujo ねぎ、鶏出汁の揚げ出し豆腐、鶏出汁の焼きおにぎり茶漬けとうどん、とさか、12本セット2,640円。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); the courses are the easy way in.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_matsunaga_wagyu_kujo.gf_detail: Ask. Shio-grilled cuts are on the menu alongside tare, miso and sukiyaki, katsu sandwiches, ramen and tempura (official site); no gluten information.
kyoto_matsunaga_wagyu_kujo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku house; salads and grilled vegetables exist but come with beef courses (official site).
kyoto_matsunaga_wagyu_kujo.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Sun and holidays 17:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Tuesday; days may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR (PayPay, WeChat Pay); no e-money (Tabelog). 36 seats: counter and private rooms for up to 10, some upstairs (Tabelog; February 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Menus in English, Chinese and Korean; English-speaking staff (Tabelog). A machiya on cobbled Shinbashi-dori near Tatsumi Shrine, 3 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; February 2025). Opened 4 January 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_matsunaga_wagyu_kujo.notes: [Wagyu yakiniku · Gion Shinbashi, since 2025] A machiya yakiniku house on cobbled Shinbashi-dori, opened in January 2025 to serve Shimane's award-winning Matsunaga Wagyu: courses that run from lobster bisque and seared wagyu nigiri through salt, tare and miso grills to sukiyaki, a wagyu katsu sandwich and ramen. Counter or private rooms; English-speaking staff. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2025 reviews: the chef handled meat at popular steakhouses such as Morton's in Tokyo and at hotel restaurants. Per the official site: Matsunaga Wagyu is mainly descended from the bull Dai-7 Itozakura and won the Prime Minister's Prize (2008) and national honour prizes (2020, 2022, 2023).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 diner liked that the lobster bisque was kept light to let the shrimp on top shine.
A February 2025 visitor arrived at dusk with the lanterns lit and was led upstairs to a private room.
A July 2026 diner finished the Meat Feast course completely stuffed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ・公式サイト: 焼肉、東山区元吉町69-3、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、月・水〜日・祝17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、火曜休み、予約可、カード・QR 可、36席、個室 (〜10名)、禁煙、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、英語を話すスタッフ、2025年1月4日オープン、島根のまつなが和牛 (A5・BMS10以上、第7糸桜の系統、内閣総理大臣賞2008年)、久成コース11,000円、サーロインステーキ付き15,400円、タン塩1,890円、シャトーブリアン8,800円、カツサンド2,200円。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年7月、英語): 新橋通の町家、料理長は東京の Morton’s やホテルの経験、オマール海老のビスク、炙り寿司、カツサンド、Meat Feast コース。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus with photos; English-speaking staff (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_bar_orange_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Mainly cocktails; food includes homemade smoked dishes and pizza (Tabelog); no gluten information.
kyoto_bar_orange_pontocho.vegan_detail: Ask. A cocktail bar; snacks such as smoked nuts and homemade chocolate (April 2025) and smoked dishes and pizza (Tabelog) — no vegan information.
kyoto_bar_orange_pontocho.hours_raw: Daily 14:00–1:00; open all year (Tabelog; the listing also carries an old notice of shorter emergency-period hours). Reservations accepted; whole-bar hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Service charge ¥330 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「330円」). 42 seats: 7 at the counter, 8 table, 8 sofa and 18 on the terrace (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Emerald Kaikan 4F, Pontocho by the Kamo River, 3 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog; April 2025).
kyoto_bar_orange_pontocho.notes: [Cocktail bar · Pontocho, Kamo River terrace] A fourth-floor bar on the Kamo River side of Pontocho with a sofa terrace over the river — kotatsu and blankets in winter, breezes in summer — open from 14:00 to 1:00. Fruit and gin cocktails made to your taste, smoked nuts, homemade chocolate, smoked dishes and pizza. Cash only; ¥330 service charge; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bar with Kamo River terrace seating, homemade smoked dishes and pizza, and a wide drink list.

anecdotes.text: A January 2024 visitor sipped coffee under a terrace kotatsu, sheltered from the wind, while friends worked through the cocktails.
A May 2022 visitor described a preference and got a gently sweet custom cocktail; blankets were handed out on the chilly terrace.
On a June 2026 summer night the staff dealt quickly with bugs drawn to the terrace lights.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・バー、中京区橋下町133-1 エメラルド会館 4F、京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、毎日14:00〜翌1:00、年中無休、予約可、貸切20〜50名、現金のみ、サービス料330円、42席 (カウンター7、テーブル8、ソファ8、テラス18)、喫煙可、鴨川を望むテラス、自家製の燻製とピザ、飲み放題付きコース4,000円。口コミ (2022年5月〜2026年6月、英語): 冬はテラスにこたつと毛布、フルーツやジンのカクテル、ランチセット1,000円、燻製ナッツ、自家製チョコレート、グラスホッパー、スイカのモヒート、ドライマティーニ。

cultural_comfort.note: Describe the flavour you like and the bartender will build a cocktail; cash only. No English evidence found.

kyoto_kin_no_tsubasa_eldor_nishiki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried set meals (croquettes, tonkatsu, karaage, fried shrimp), cold noodles and tare-grilled kalbi (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kin_no_tsubasa_eldor_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat and fish set meals, Korean dishes and yakitori (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kin_no_tsubasa_eldor_nishiki.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–22:30, lunch 11:30–15:30; closing days not fixed. Reservations taken. Cash only according to reviewers (April 2023; July 2026), though Tabelog lists cards — bring cash. 51 seats including a 19-seat counter and a second floor; banquets up to 35. Non-smoking (no smoking at lunch). In a renovated townhouse on Higashinotoin at Nishiki, opposite the market entrance, 2 min from Karasuma / Shijo.
kyoto_kin_no_tsubasa_eldor_nishiki.notes: [Izakaya & lunch sets · Higashinotoin at Nishiki, sub-¥1,000 set meals] A busy townhouse izakaya opposite the Nishiki entrance with a long list of cheap lunch sets — grilled fish, tonkatsu, karaage, bibimbap and Korean cold noodles mostly under ¥1,000 — turning to yakitori and Korean dishes at night. Cash only, reviewers say. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists it as a corporate member. Reviewers from 2022 to 2026 praise the range and value of the lunch sets at a time of rising prices, and a lively crowd of office workers and shoppers; criticism: kalbi "a slight dryness" (December 2025) and Korean cold noodles that one diner found "a bit unappealing" (August 2025).

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "For just JPY 980, you get grilled fish as the main dish, along with kara-age, dashimaki (Japanese omelette), thick fried tofu, and a small side dish!"
July 2026: "Upon arrival, I was informed that only cash payments were accepted."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 金の翼 エルドール、居酒屋・韓国料理・魚介料理、中京区東洞院通錦小路東入ル西魚屋町622 (四条高倉上ル錦市場前)、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩2分、毎日 11:30〜22:30、ランチ 11:30〜15:30、不定休、予約可、51席 (カウンター19)、禁煙 (昼は禁煙)、カード可とあるが口コミでは現金のみ、法人会員。口コミ (2022年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 町家を改装、日替わりランチ850円 (コロッケ、とんかつ、唐揚げ、味噌汁、大根の煮物)、焼き魚定食980円 (税抜、唐揚げ・だし巻き・厚揚げ付き)、とんかつ定食990円、ビビンバと韓国冷麺のセット950円、石焼ビビンバ、サラダ冷麺、カルビ焼き定食1,023円、大海老フライ定食1,375円、刺身定食、夜は焼き鳥と韓国料理、現金のみ (2023年4月、2026年7月)、カルビが少しパサつく (2025年12月)。

kyoto_muqam_uyghur_gion.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: laghman noodles, flaky lamb buns, dumplings and fried rice-noodle dishes in wheat-based sauces (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_muqam_uyghur_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: lamb- and beef-centred menu; Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options — ask which (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_muqam_uyghur_gion.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri and holidays 17:00–22:00 (food last order 21:30); Sat and Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–22:00 (weekend lunch since March 2026); closed Wednesday. Reservations taken. 27 seats plus standing room for 40. Non-smoking; free Wi-Fi. Cards, e-money and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay and others). Tabelog tags halal, vegan and vegetarian options; no operator halal certification is cited, so the halal flag stays off. Ground floor of SAKIZO祇園花見小路ビル, north Hanamikoji. A reviewer had visited a Namba branch (October 2025).
kyoto_muqam_uyghur_gion.notes: [Uyghur · north Hanamikoji, Gion, cumin lamb and laghman] A bazaar-lit Uyghur dining room off Hanamikoji run by Xinjiang natives: cumin-chilli lamb skewers, flaky lamb buns, laghman and fat spicy Xinjiang rice noodles, with Uyghur beer. Big portions for sharing. Dinner daily except Wednesday, plus weekend lunch.

chef_bio.origin: Xinjiang (owner and staff, per a September 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: A September 2025 reviewer writes that "the ingredients, owner, and waitstaff all come from Xinjiang"; another had eaten at a Namba branch about three years before (October 2025). Reviewers praise authentic cumin-led flavours and large portions; one April 2026 diner noted Japanese is spoken by the staff, and the Xinjiang beer was sold out on a September 2026 visit.
chef_bio.specialty: Lamb skewers; Xinjiang fried rice noodles.

anecdotes.text: September 2025: "The outer layer is made of multiple flaky pastry layers that are crispy on the outside, and when you break it open, hot, juicy lamb fat spills out."
April 2026: "I visited for the first time since they started lunch service on weekends in March."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 新疆ウイグル料理ムカーム 京都店、アジア・エスニック、東山区清本町352 SAKIZO祇園花見小路ビル 1F、京阪祇園四条駅9番出口から徒歩約6分、月・火・木・金・祝 17:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 21:30)、土日 11:30〜14:30・17:00〜22:00、水曜休み、予約可、27席、立食40名、禁煙、Wi-Fi、カード・電子マネー・QR可、ハラル・ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン対応の表記、トルコランプの内装、法人会員。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年9月、英語): 店主もスタッフも新疆出身 (2025年9月)、羊肉串400円、鶏の串、羊のパイ包み、羊の水餃子、ウイグル風サラダ、人気の新疆米粉 (牛か鶏、辛さ2段階)、ラグメン、新疆ヨーグルト、新疆のビール、2026年3月から週末ランチ、難波にも店 (2025年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Multilingual staff (Japanese and Chinese); halal options tagged, not certified.

kyoto_fruits_nakazawa_daimaru.gf_detail: Ask: fresh fruit juices without added sugar may suit; soft-serve topping not checked (2016–2025 reviews).
kyoto_fruits_nakazawa_daimaru.vegan_detail: Ask: 100% fruit and vegetable juices may suit; mixed juices and soft serve may contain milk (2016–2025 reviews).
kyoto_fruits_nakazawa_daimaru.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 10:00–20:00, closing days follow Daimaru Kyoto. No charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「なし」. A juice stand in the basement food hall of Daimaru Kyoto near the Nishiki-side entrance (May 2018), with a few benches and tables nearby to drink on the spot (June 2022; March 2025). Non-smoking. Cards (JCB per Tabelog), e-money and QR. Directly connected to Karasuma / Shijo stations.
kyoto_fruits_nakazawa_daimaru.notes: [Juice stand · Daimaru Kyoto basement, fruit cut and blended to order] A small juice counter in Daimaru's food hall where apples, peaches or kiwi are cut and blended as you order — no added sugar — plus a classic mixed juice with an optional soft-serve float. A few benches nearby. Open with the store, 10:00–20:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers since 2016 describe a juice stand in Daimaru Kyoto's basement where the fruit is cut and blended fresh for each order and the juices carry no added sugar (May 2018); one 2018 reviewer found it "a bit high" in price but worth it, and March and July 2025 reviewers praised the apple and Okayama peach juices. No source gives the operator or other shops.

anecdotes.text: March 2025: "After placing the order, I could hear the sound of the apples being cut fresh, which added to the delightful experience!"
July 2025: "They cut the fruit and blend it fresh for each order, making it incredibly delicious and refreshing."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フルーツ中澤 大丸京都店、ジューススタンド・ジェラート・アイスクリーム、下京区立売西町79 大丸京都店 B1F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅直結、毎日 10:00〜20:00 (大丸京都店に準じる)、原文でサービス料「なし」、禁煙、カード (JCB)・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2016年1月〜2025年7月、英語): 大丸の地下の錦側の入口近く、注文ごとに果物を切って搾る、砂糖不使用、りんご、グレープフルーツ、岡山の桃、キウイ、日替わりの桃、ミックスジュース350円とソフトクリームのトッピング100円、キウイミックス420円、紫野菜と赤ぶどう450円、マンゴーのビッグトロピカル580円、アイスコーヒー、緑茶、近くにベンチとテーブル、やや高め (2018年)。

kyoto_art_mon_zen_the_terrace.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: afternoon-tea pastries and course breads; the afternoon tea cannot accommodate wheat, dairy, egg, nut, chocolate or fruit allergies (official site).
kyoto_art_mon_zen_the_terrace.vegan_detail: Not vegan: French courses with fish, duck and dairy; no allergy accommodation for afternoon tea (official site; reviews).
kyoto_art_mon_zen_the_terrace.hours_raw: Official site: THE TERRACE café and lunch Wed–Sun 11:30–17:00 (course last order 14:00, à la carte and café 16:15) until 8 December 2026; from 9 December 11:30–15:00 (course last order 13:00, café 14:00); closed Monday and Tuesday; temporary closures possible. Seasonal lunch course by reservation the day before by 17:00; café seating 90 minutes, weekend courses 120 minutes. Afternoon tea (SNOW WHITE, 21 October – 6 December 2026, then a new period to 31 January 2027) by reservation the day before by 11:00, two or more people, 120 minutes, with free-flow drinks; no allergy accommodation. Breakfast and dinner are for hotel guests only (breakfast opened to the public in limited periods). No children under six. Cards (Amex per Tabelog). Basement lounge of the small hotel ART MON ZEN KYOTO on Furumonzen-dori east of Yamatooji.
kyoto_art_mon_zen_the_terrace.notes: [French lunch & afternoon tea · Furumonzen, a boutique art hotel's lounge] The basement lounge of a small art-and-antiques hotel near Gion, open to non-guests for French lunch courses, café and elaborate free-flow afternoon teas among museum-grade pieces. Book a day ahead; no under-sixes. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A January 2026 reviewer describes "a hotel restaurant owned by an art dealer in Kyoto"; other reviewers note museum-quality antiques (January 2024), a sukiya-and-Western interior with a sunken-hearth tatami room (June 2024) and attentive phone service (January 2024). Criticism: the breakfast mains disappointed one October 2025 guest. The official site lists the hotel's Kyoto kaiseki restaurant 祇園松むろ about 20 m west.

anecdotes.text: January 2024: "It feels like stepping into an art museum!"
January 2026: "A hotel restaurant owned by an art dealer in Kyoto. I had the pleasure of enjoying some truly exquisite French cuisine after a long time."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ART MON ZEN KYOTO 内レストラン「THE TERRACE」、地下のラウンジエリアで朝食・ランチ・カフェ、数寄屋と西洋建築の空間、カフェ・ランチは月・火定休、11:30〜17:00 (コース L.O. 14:00、アラカルト・カフェ L.O. 16:15)、12/9以降は11:30〜15:00、シーズナルコースは前日17時までに予約、朝食とディナーは宿泊客のみ (朝食は期間限定で一般も)、アフタヌーンティー「SNOW WHITE」(2026年10月21日〜12月6日、前日11時までに予約、2名から、120分、フリーフロー30種、アレルギー対応不可)、未就学児不可、京懐石「祇園松むろ」は約20m西。食べログ: 東山区古門前通大和大路東入元町391、三条京阪から260m、カード (AMEX) 可。口コミ (2020年9月〜2026年1月、英語): 美術館のような骨董、ランチコース4,500円 (生ハムとリコッタのムース、冬瓜の冷製スープ、いさきのポワレ、マンゴーゼリー)、テリーヌ、かぼちゃのスープ、あじのポワレ、モンブラン、海老芋のリゾット、イベリコハム、かつおとかますのブールブラン、鴨のロースト、ローズ＆ベリーのアフタヌーンティー6,413円 (2023年4月)、京都の美術商が営むホテルのレストラン (2026年1月)、朝食の主菜が物足りない (2025年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant open to non-guests at lunch; book a day ahead; no under-sixes.

kyoto_shinkirou_miyagawacho.gf_detail: Not GF: tempura and karaage among the lunch mains, red miso soup and soy-seasoned obanzai (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shinkirou_miyagawacho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based obanzai, fish, chicken and duck (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shinkirou_miyagawacho.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); closing days irregular (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — walk-ins have been turned away when full (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 36 seats at counter and tables; two private rooms upstairs for 7–10 each, one tatami, up to 20 for private hire (Tabelog). Shoes off at the entrance (May and August 2026). Non-smoking; ashtray outside (Tabelog). Miyagawa-cho, 3 min walk from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_shinkirou_miyagawacho.notes: [Obanzai · Miyagawa-cho machiya] A shoes-off townhouse in the Miyagawa-cho geisha quarter: the ¥1,800 lunch plate brings some twenty little obanzai with your choice of two mains — sashimi, tempura, karaage or the daily special — and evenings pair Kyoto vegetables and duck with junmai sake. Book ahead; walk-ins are often full.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an obanzai and sake restaurant in Miyagawa-cho with a second-floor private room. Its website is part of MASTERMIND株式会社, a Kyoto restaurant company; a May 2026 reviewer notes the same group runs Gyoza Ryo Sho and other restaurants. A November 2024 lunch guest saw two people handling cooking and service.
chef_bio.philosophy: Simple Japanese food with a little finesse, Kyoto vegetables, and junmai sake (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 lunch guest glimpsed a maiko performing upstairs for a group of overseas visitors.
An August 2026 solo traveller was told almost every dish could be made for one, and made many requests.
An August 2026 couple who booked the day before watched walk-ins turned away for lack of seats.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・郷土料理・海鮮、東山区宮川筋6丁目361、京阪清水五条駅から徒歩3分、毎日 11:30〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)、17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、不定休、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・電子マネー可、QR 不可、36席、2階に個室 (座敷・テーブル各1、7〜10名)、20名まで貸切可、禁煙 (店外に灰皿)、宮川町の京のおばんざいと純米酒中心の日本酒、京野菜と鴨の料理。公式サイト: MASTERMIND株式会社のサイト内。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 1,800円のワンプレートランチ (おばんざい約20種、豆腐、ご飯、赤だし、天ぷら・刺身・唐揚げ・日替わりから2品)、日替わりは鶏の味噌煮や魚のあら炊き、靴を脱いで上がる町家、2階で舞妓の舞 (2026年5月)、ほとんどの料理を一人前で頼める (2026年8月)、予約なしの客が入れなかった (2026年8月)、亮昌などを運営するグループの店との声 (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off; book ahead; cards and IC.

kyoto_abrakadabra_gion.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat noodles in soy or chicken broth (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_abrakadabra_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken paitan and pork-fat ramen with chashu (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_abrakadabra_gion.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 1:00–7:00 (late night to morning); closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: two counters of 7 and 5, and two tables for 4 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). At the end of a narrow alley north off Sueyoshi-cho, under a red lantern (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened in early spring 2024 (April 2024).
kyoto_abrakadabra_gion.notes: [Ramen · Gion alley, 1–7 a.m.] A red-lantern ramen bar down a Gion alley that opens at 1 a.m. and serves until 7: a thick chicken paitan, a lighter shoyu bowl and a fat-rich abura soba, the after-drinks stop for the neighbourhood. Ask which bowl is richest — the shoyu is lighter than the name suggests. Cash only; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a 20-seat late-night ramen shop in a narrow Gion alley, open from 1:00 to 7:00, that opened in early spring 2024 with three kinds of ramen.

anecdotes.text: An April 2024 visitor came just before 6 a.m. for a bowl of chicken paitan at ¥880, suggesting a morning ramen as much as a late-night one.
A September 2025 diner found the chicken paitan lukewarm and too salty, and the mozuku plain shop-bought.
A September 2026 visitor advises asking which bowls are the rich ones, since the recommendations differed from what the name suggests.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラーメン、東山区八坂新地清本町375、末吉町通から路地を北へ、月〜土 1:00〜7:00、日・祝休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、20席 (カウンター7席と5席、4人掛けテーブル2卓)、喫煙可、焼酎あり。口コミ (2024年2月〜2026年9月、英語): 2024年の早春に開店、深夜から朝まで、赤提灯、ラーメンは3種類、鶏白湯880円 (濃厚でなめらか、揚げ玉ねぎ、ストレート麺、チャーシュー、メンマ、ねぎ)、あっさりの醤油ラーメン、脂多めの油そば、味玉、沖縄のもずく、ぬるくしょっぱかったとの声 (2025年9月)、名前のわりにあっさりとの声 (2025年12月)、濃いものを聞いて頼むとよいとの声 (2026年9月)。

kyoto_beans_tei.gf_detail: Black coffee only — no food is described (2025–2026 reviews). Plain coffee is gluten-free; ask about anything added.
kyoto_beans_tei.vegan_detail: Black hot and iced coffee only (May 2025; August 2026); plain coffee is plant-based.
kyoto_beans_tei.hours_raw: Monday and Thursday–Sunday 11:00–19:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog); take-away coffee from 12:00 (December 2025). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). A counter shop of self-roasted beans with a small standing corner; coffee to take away, hot or iced, black, one size (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Takakura just south of Nishikikoji, at the west end of Nishiki Market by Daimaru; 252 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; 2025 reviews).
kyoto_beans_tei.notes: [Coffee stand · Takakura by Nishiki] A tiny self-roasting bean shop a step from Nishiki Market, with jars of beans along the counter and a strong cup to take away for ¥280 — ¥20 less if you skip the lid. Beans ground to order, from house blends to Ethiopian single origins. Cash only; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a self-roasting coffee bean shop near the Nishiki Market exit and Daimaru, selling blends and single origins with take-away coffee; a December 2025 reviewer had heard it was featured on the NHK programme 72 Hours. An August 2026 regular describes a lively, cheerful owner, often there at weekends and in the evening.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 Sunday visitor learned the iced coffee is ¥20 cheaper without a lid and drank it strolling the neighbourhood.
A December 2025 guest arrived ten minutes before take-away began at noon, and watched a steady line buying beans.
A July 2026 customer described tastes to the staff and was steered to the Mild Blend, good hot or iced.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: コーヒースタンド、中京区高倉通錦小路下ル (番地の表示なし)、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅、月・木〜日 11:00〜19:00、火・水休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙、テイクアウト、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年8月、英語): 錦市場の出口と大丸のそば、自家焙煎の豆の店、カウンターに豆の大瓶、立ち飲みのコーナー、持ち帰りのコーヒーはホットかアイスのブラックで1サイズ、ホット280円、アイス380円、ふたなしで20円引き、豆はブレンドからシングルオリジンまで (Rich Honey Blend 100g 約800円、Mild Blend、エチオピア イルガチェフェ G2)、挽いてもらえる、ドリップバッグ、持ち帰りは12時から (2025年12月)、NHK の番組で紹介されたとの声、明るい店主 (2026年8月)。

kyoto_tempura_gen_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat-batter tempura over rice with a soy-based sauce (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tempura_gen_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shrimp, anago, kisu and scallop tempura, egg, miso soup (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tempura_gen_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Friday–Sunday 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–20:30; Thursday 17:00–20:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Same prices at lunch and dinner (August 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards and QR (Tabelog; November 2025). Eight counter seats and one table at the back (May and November 2025). 1F of the Oriental Kaikan on Kiyamachi, just over Sanjo Ohashi; 2 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tempura_gen_kiyamachi.notes: [Tempura · Kiyamachi-Sanjo counter] A small counter by the Kamo run by a couple, frying generous tendon to order: two big shrimp and vegetables with a soft egg, or the limited seafood bowl with an anago spilling over the rim. Light batter, free large rice and refills of miso soup and pickles, same price day and night. Closed Wednesday; no Thursday lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a tempura counter of about eight seats on Kiyamachi run by a couple (September and October 2025), frying in oil blended by Yamanaka Aburaten, a Kyoto oil shop of nearly 200 years (August 2025), under a large painting by Daruma Shoten (May 2025).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 diner took the middle counter seat, facing a large, humorous and slightly eerie painting by Daruma Shoten.
An October 2025 guest, there with a parent, found the couple running the counter perfectly in step, the scallops still rare inside.
A November 2025 visitor from Kanto found the dipping sauce not sweet enough and the batter thicker than preferred.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 天ぷら、中京区木屋町通石屋町126 オリエンタル会館 1F、三条駅から125m、月・火・金〜日 11:30〜14:30、17:00〜20:30、木 17:00〜20:30、水曜休み、予約可、カード・QR 可。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年7月、英語): 夫婦で営む (2025年9・10月)、カウンター8席ほどと奥にテーブル1卓、Yamanaka Aburaten の油、天丼1,600円、特製天丼 A・B 各1,980円、数量限定の海鮮天丼3,580円 (穴子一本、海老、きす、帆立、半熟卵)、天ぷら定食に抹茶塩、ご飯大盛り無料、味噌汁と漬物のおかわり自由、昼も夜も同じ値段、Daruma Shoten の大きな絵、つゆの甘さが足りず衣が厚めとの声 (2025年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; cards and QR; same prices day and night.
